methodologyNotes: Self-serve travel eSIM plan pricing collected on 2026-06-14 from each vendor's official storefront and, where the official page returned 403/empty/EUR-only, from a reputable 2026 pricing-comparison page. eSIM data plans are one-time purchases (not subscriptions) unless explicitly noted as a recurring subscription; per schema rules a pure one-time purchase carries monthlyUsd = null with the one-time price in notes. Holafly's monthly subscription tiers are an exception and carry a monthlyUsd value. All prices are in USD. Airalo's storefront consistently geolocates to EUR (confirmed across 15+ page fetches); USD prices were not directly observable and Airalo is therefore excluded to avoid fabrication. Saily's domain returned HTTP 403 on all fetch attempts; pricing cannot be verified and Saily is excluded. Nomad's storefront shows EUR; USD prices were corroborated from the esimdb.com Malaysia comparison article (published 2026-03-01) cross-checked against the Nomad homepage header which states 'from US$ 3'. minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall are null on every plan (non-telephony service). hipaa and baa are null for all vendors (not applicable to consumer travel data). bilingual is null (not a meaningful differentiator for eSIM retail). integrations are [] throughout (no software integrations advertised).
